name: Arugula Salad with Chicken, Chickpeas & Creamy Cilantro Dressing

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ orange bell peppers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Zest limes into a small bowl (reserve limes for later use). Add spices and stir to combine the spice mix.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with the spice mix.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems. Place stems and half of the leaves in a blender. (Reserve remaining leaves for serving.)

Juice reserved limes into the blender, then add yogurt, oil, water, honey, and salt. Blend on high until smooth. Add additional water, a few teaspoons at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set dressing aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp water
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a large bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers.
Add chickpeas and arugula to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing, then top with chicken, pickled onions, and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
